dialogs.about: 딸과 집에서 아침을 먹으며 카페 나들이를 이야기함

lines.en: Mom, do you want toast this morning?
Yes, please. With butter and a little jam.
lines.ko: 네, 주세요. 버터랑 잼을 조금 발라서요.

lines.en: Here you are. Your mug is on the table.
Thank you. This warm tea is good.
Should we go to the new cafe today?
That's a good idea. Is it near the park?
Yes. Their croissant and muffin are very good.
lines.ko: 네. 거기 크루아상이랑 머핀이 아주 맛있어요.

lines.en: I ate a cookie there last month.
I will buy a latte for you.
Wonderful. Let's share one dessert together.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 디저트는 하나만 같이 나눠 먹어요.

lines.en: Hello. May I have a warm latte, please?
lines.ko: 안녕하세요. 따뜻한 라테 한 잔 주시겠어요?

lines.en: Of course. In a large mug or a cup?
lines.ko: 물론이죠. 큰 머그잔에 드릴까요, 컵에 드릴까요?

lines.en: A large mug, please. It is cold outside.
Would you like a croissant or a muffin?
The croissant, please. Is it fresh today?
Yes. We baked it one hour ago.
Wonderful. My friend loves your cookies too.
lines.ko: 좋네요. 제 친구는 여기 쿠키도 아주 좋아해요.

lines.en: Thank you. Do you want jam and butter?
A little jam, please. No dessert today.
Okay. I will bring everything to your table.
